result.instructions: Tools for Gladly, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the customer with the email jane@example.com and show her last 5 conversations."; "Show the full timeline of conversation 9BcE2O0DQ2ynGHRmk9FeoA."; "Which tasks are still open for this customer?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Gladly data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run gladly_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run gladly_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run gladly_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. gladly_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: gladly_get_organization
tools.title: Get the organization
tools.description: Get metadata about the Gladly organization: id, name, login domain, time zone, URL. Gladly API: GET /api/v1/organization.

tools.name: gladly_list_agents
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: List the agents (support users) with id, name and email address. Gladly API: GET /api/v1/agents.

tools.name: gladly_get_agent
tools.title: Get an agent
tools.description: Get one agent profile by id. Gladly API: GET /api/v1/agents/{agentId}.

tools.name: gladly_list_inboxes
tools.title: List inboxes
tools.description: List the inboxes with id, name and disabled state. Gladly API: GET /api/v1/inboxes.

tools.name: gladly_get_inbox
tools.title: Get an inbox
tools.description: Get the metadata of one inbox by id. Gladly API: GET /api/v1/inboxes/{inboxId}.

tools.name: gladly_list_topics
tools.title: List topics
tools.description: List the conversation topics (id, name, parentId, disabled). Use it to turn the topicIds of a conversation into names. Gladly API: GET /api/v1/topics.

tools.name: gladly_list_audiences
tools.title: List audiences
tools.description: List the audiences used to target answers (id, name). Gladly API: GET /api/v1/audiences.

tools.name: gladly_find_customers
tools.title: Find customers
tools.description: Find customer profiles by EXACTLY ONE identifier: email, phone number (E.164, for example +16505551987) or externalCustomerId. Returns at most 50 profiles, newest update first. Gladly API: GET /api/v1/customer-profiles.

phone_number.description: Phone number in E.164 format, for example +16505551987.

external_customer_id.description: Customer id in your own system of record (only for older Lookup Adaptors).

tools.name: gladly_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer profile by id: name, emails, phones, address, custom attributes. Gladly API: GET /api/v1/customer-profiles/{customerId}.

tools.name: gladly_list_customer_conversations
tools.title: List conversations of a customer
tools.description: List the conversations of one customer, oldest first (at most 100; the reply says if it was cut). Each has topics, status and assignee. Gladly API: GET /api/v1/customers/{customerId}/conversations.

tools.name: gladly_get_conversation
tools.title: Get a conversation
tools.description: Get the metadata of one conversation: assignee, inbox, topics, custom attributes, status. A merged conversation returns the surviving one. Gladly API: GET /api/v1/conversations/{conversationId}.

tools.name: gladly_list_conversation_items
tools.title: List the timeline of a conversation
tools.description: List the timeline items of a conversation (messages, emails, calls, notes), oldest first, at most 1000. Gladly API: GET /api/v1/conversations/{conversationId}/items.

session_id.description: Only items of this session id.

annotations.title: List the timeline of a conversation

tools.name: gladly_get_conversation_item
tools.title: Get a conversation item
tools.description: Get one conversation item (message, email, note, call) by id. Gladly API: GET /api/v1/conversation-items/{itemId}.

tools.name: gladly_list_customer_tasks
tools.title: List tasks of a customer
tools.description: List the tasks of one customer, newest first (at most 2000), optionally only OPEN or CLOSED. Gladly API: GET /api/v1/customers/{customerId}/tasks.

tools.name: gladly_get_task
tools.title: Get a task
tools.description: Get one task by id: body, assignee, due date, status, topics. Gladly API: GET /api/v1/tasks/{taskId}.

tools.name: gladly_add_conversation_note
tools.title: Add an internal note to a conversation
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal note to a conversation. The note is for agents only; the customer does not see it. Each call adds a NEW note, so do not repeat a call that succeeded. Gladly API: POST /api/v1/conversations/{conversationId}/notes.

annotations.title: Add an internal note to a conversation

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Gladly
prompts.description: What you can do with Gladly here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: pull_up_a_customer_and_review_their_conversations
prompts.title: Pull up a customer and review their conversations
prompts.description: Find a customer by email, phone number or external id. Then list their conversations with topics, status and assignee, oldest first, so an agent sees the history.

prompts.name: read_the_timeline_of_one_conversation
prompts.title: Read the timeline of one conversation
prompts.description: Open a conversation and list its messages, emails, calls and notes in order. Ask the assistant for a short summary before you take over the case.

prompts.name: check_which_tasks_are_still_open_for_a_customer
prompts.title: Check which tasks are still open for a customer
prompts.description: List the open tasks of a customer with assignee and due date. Use it to see which follow-ups are late before you answer the customer.

prompts.name: map_topics_inboxes_and_agents_to_names
prompts.title: Map topics, inboxes and agents to names
prompts.description: Turn the topic, inbox and agent ids of a conversation into names. Use it to see who owns the case and where it sits.

prompts.name: add_an_internal_note_after_a_customer_contact
prompts.title: Add an internal note after a customer contact
prompts.description: Write an internal note on a conversation, for example a call back request. Only agents see the note. Each call adds a new note.
